comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Already addressed on `main`. The token is persisted and reloaded via the connection serializer path; see `XmlConnectionNodeSerializer28.cs:194` (write) and `XmlConnectionsDeserializer.cs:620` (read). Inherited values are resolved in `ConnectionInfo.TryGetInheritedPropertyValue` on demand, so parent→child inheritance of the gateway token works out of the box on the current nightly.
